column1: # Source files for tools/fwsrc.py: `start end name [evidence]`. The range [start, end)
# becomes <name>.s, in its own section .text.<name>; the linker keeps stock order. Ranges
# left out become gap_<start>.s. A range must start on a layout unit, and only wide
# branches (bl, b.w) and data words may refer across files.
# Only ranges with evidence for their extent: the image has no source file names.
0800c000 0800c1ac vectors                vector table: 107 words up to the image header
0800c1ac 0800c1d0 image_header           "MAIN" + BCD version, read by the bootloader (sysex-handlers.md)
08026d98 0802aec8 rodata                 constant data after the last function and its pool: session_defaults, vtables, tables, strings
0802aeec 0802bb20 data                   .data load image: Reset_Handler copies it to 0x20000000-0x20000C18
